title: Decentralized Web Summit - Live From The Internet Archive
summary: Full-day livestream of the 2016 Decentralized Web Summit at the Internet Archive, with speakers including Vint Cerf, Tim Berners-Lee, Brewster Kahle, Cory Doctorow and Mitchell Baker. It explores the technology and impact of a decentralized web.
why: Cited as primary footage of web pioneers discussing the future of the internet, such as Berners-Lee's concerns.

quote.text: TBL is definitely worried about the future of internet.
